question: If a spell with squad is countered, are any tokens created?

expected.shortAnswer: No: if the spell is countered, squad does not trigger and no tokens are created.
expected.answer: If the spell is countered, the squad ability will not trigger, and no tokens will be created.

whyHard: Squad is paid for as a cost, so players expect the tokens even if the creature never enters.
